notes: Frozen corpus snapshot. PDFs live under sources/ (gitignored) and are re-downloadable from `url`; verify with sha256. `ocr_pages` uses Surya's 0-based inclusive page_range syntax; null = all pages; "text-layer" = clean embedded text, no OCR needed. Legacy Marathi fonts (DV-TTSurekh, Sakal Marathi, DVOT-Yogesh) give corrupted text layers, so those documents must be OCR'd. `ocr_corrections` are human-verified find/replace fixes on one Surya (1-based) page, applied at build time; raw OCR output is never edited, and a fix that does not match exactly once fails the build.
